about: The power gate's damage brackets, game data 1.4.002: a team keeps damage_pct% of its final damage in the highest bracket whose min_ratio_pct is at or below team power / recommended power x 100. Stepwise, no interpolation; the same table gates main stages and Dimensional Rift levels. Copied from evidence/06-derived/brackets.json (crumblehub's stage tool) and checked against crumb.gg's stages.json in evidence/06-derived/crumbgg-comparison.json, which lists no step under 10%.
